descriptionHtml:
Memory foam. Raised sides. The sofa arm, without the sofa.

Haweswater is a memory foam dog sofa bed with raised sides, in Medium (76 × 63cm), Large (89 × 63cm) and XL. The cover comes off and machine washes.

Some dogs do not want a bed at all. They want the arm of your sofa: chin up, eyes half open, close enough to hear you move. Take it away and they lie on the floor with their head on your foot.

The raised sides give them the same thing at their own height, with the memory foam base keeping the rest of them off the boards.

What they get

  • A memory foam base: The resting surface is memory foam rather than loose filling that shifts under them.
  • A raised edge for a raised head: Sofa-style sides to prop a chin on and keep watch.
  • Three sizes from 76 × 63cm: Choose the footprint around your dog, not the other way round.
  • A machine-washable cover: It comes off for washing and the foam stays out of the machine.

Best for: dogs who sleep with their head up on the sofa arm, the step or your foot, and anyone who wants the bed by their chair.

Why it is worth the money

A cheap bed that is flat by spring is not the cheaper option. You pay for it more often. The foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, which is 1825 nights. On that basis the £79 Medium is about 4p a night, the £89 Large about 5p and the £119 XL about 7p.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Two things to know. We do not publish the XL measurements and will not make them up, so message us before ordering that size. There is no waterproof liner in this one either.

Size and fit

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the raised sides take up some of that, so between sizes, size up. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry it fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We can describe the bed, not the outcome. It is a memory foam base with raised sides to rest a head on, in three sizes. Whether that is the right resting surface is a conversation for your vet.
